summary: Implemented the provider-neutral, plugin-owned source-artwork provenance and guarded restoration state in src/ArrTags/Artwork, following docs/data-model.md sections 3.10.1 and 3.10.2 and ADR-002. ArtworkImageSurface is the canonical image-surface identity (V1 unindexed Primary; the optional index is retained and the state validator rejects an indexed surface as out of V1 scope). ActiveImageIdentity records surface, explicit Present/Absent presence, content SHA-256, byte length, dimensions, modification time, and the Jellyfin image tag, with no path. ArtworkOwnershipComparer applies the fail-closed rule: surface and presence must match; a present comparison requires matching content hashes; every recorded Jellyfin value must still match when observable; a missing hash, missing observation, or mismatched surface is Unknown, a content/presence/supporting-value difference is Changed, and only a full match is Owned. PublishedArtworkState carries modelVersion, jellyfinItemId, imageSurface, state (NotPublished, Published, OwnershipLost, OwnershipUnknown, RestorePending, Restored, RestoreBlocked, Removed), sourcePresence, sourceArtifactId, sourceFingerprint, sourceCaptureIdentity, ownershipToken, publicationToken, activeImageIdentity, publishedFingerprint, rendererVersion, lastOwnershipObservation, stateRevision, lastOperationId, and updatedAt, with Validate enforcing a complete publication set, a present active identity with a hash, a retained artifact plus fingerprint for a present baseline (forbidden for an absent baseline), well-formed bounded opaque tokens, a non-indexed surface, and model-version compatibility. PublishedArtworkStateTransitions implements every documented transition as pure decisions and commits (new session capture, repeated publication reusing the source artifact and ownership token while issuing a new publication token and active identity, OwnershipLost on mismatch, OwnershipUnknown on unobservable, RestorePending, source-restore/removal authorization only after a fresh match and source-integrity check, Restored only after a verified restoration, RestoreBlocked on a missing/corrupt source or unverifiable result, and Removed with no image mutation), performs no Jellyfin image mutation, and refuses to automatically re-baseline OwnershipLost/OwnershipUnknown/RestoreBlocked. SourceArtifactStore is the content-addressed immutable store under the plugin data folder (artifacts/source sharded by hash) that retains exact bytes plus MIME type, byte length, and SHA-256, atomically promotes after bounded size/MIME/magic-byte/hash validation, validates integrity on read, is traversal-safe, promotes idempotently, and rejects new work when the authoritative storage quota would be exceeded. PublishedArtworkStateStore persists the state through the existing versioned, integrity-tagged, atomically-written authoritative boundary, enforcing the invariants on write and quarantining a valid-envelope-but-invalid record rather than replaying it. StateRepository gained a read-only Limits accessor so the store shares the configured bounds. The durable ArtworkOperation journal (5.6), the host source adapter (5.3), publication (5.5), reconciliation (5.7), and lifecycle fencing (5.9) remain later tasks; no ADR, RenderVersion, renderer behavior, or existing passing behavior was changed.

known_limitations: No Jellyfin image mutation, host source read, publication, item update, or ArtworkOperation journal is implemented, by task scope. The transition component models the decisions and required actions (ArtworkTransitionAction) so tasks 5.5/5.7/5.9 can drive them.

Artifact bytes are not garbage-collected in this task. The store enforces the authoritative ArtifactStorageQuotaBytes by rejecting new promotions when the quota would be exceeded (ADR-004 safe behavior), and terminal state records are pruned by the existing terminal-provenance retention, but reference-proven cleanup of unreferenced artifact bytes is deferred to the reconciliation/retention work (5.7). Long-running deployments could reach the quota with unreferenced artifacts and then reject new work rather than evict provenance.

A surface mismatch is classified as OwnershipUnknown (fail-closed) rather than Changed, because observing a different surface does not tell us what happened to the expected surface; both block automatic mutation. This is documented in the comparer.

LastOwnershipObservation is required for Published/RestorePending but not for a freshly captured NotPublished session, which has no comparison yet; the data model marks the field required, and this is the smallest safe reading for a capture that precedes any publication.

The two new stores are public and directly constructible but are not yet registered in ArrTagsServiceRegistrator; DI wiring for them belongs with the publication/reconciliation tasks that consume them.

No live/host or native-Skia validation was performed for this task because it performs no image work; the environment-guarded Skia and host-route tests remain skipped under the default run exactly as before.
